Name: Weight of Moving Object
Description: Mass or gravitational force is the cause of the object's movement. Motion is a situation where there is relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved; it can be linear displacement or rotational motion.
Keyword: Load, burden, weightlessness, lightness.

Name: Weight of Stationary Object
Description: Mass or gravitational force is the cause of the object's immobility. Stationary is a situation where there is no relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved.
Keyword: Load, burden, lightness.

Name: Length/Angle of Moving Object
Description: Any length or angular measurement related to the displacement or mobility of the object.
Keyword: Width, height, depth, distance, range, span, separation.

Name: Length/Angle of Stationary Object
Description: Any length or angular measurement related to the immobility of the object. Stationary is a situation where there is no relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved.
Keyword: Width, height, depth, distance, range, span, separation.

Name: Area of Moving Object
Description: Any dimension related to surfaces or surface area. These can be internal or external surfaces. Motion is a situation where there is relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved.
Keyword: Zone, space, section, contact point.

Name: Area of Stationary Object
Description: Any dimension related to surfaces or surface area. These can be internal or external surfaces. Stationary is a situation where there is no relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved.
Keyword: Zone, space, section, contact point.

Name: Volume of Moving Object
Description: Anything related to the measurement of volume occupied by the object or the space surrounding the object. Motion is a situation where there is relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved.
Keyword: Capacity, space, room, size, bulkiness, compactness.

Name: Volume of Stationary Object
Description: Anything related to the measurement of volume occupied by the object or the space surrounding the object. Stationary is a situation where there is no relative displacement between two or more parts related to the problem to be solved.
Keyword: Capacity, space, room, size, bulkiness, compactness.

Name: Shape
Description: The contour or profile (internal or external) of a part or object required for Ergonomics and functionality rather than aesthetic reasons. Ergonomics or Human Factors is the scientific discipline studying the relationship between humans and the working environment, especially in terms of 'use'. To make products most suitable for users, designers must ensure equipment and working environments suit the capabilities and limitations of those using them.
Keyword: Pattern, profile, form, projection (shadow), sketch, geometry, curvature.

Name: Amount of Substance
Description: The total, quantity, or count of materials, substances, or parts of the system.
Keyword: Quantity, matter, material, density.

Name: Amount of Information
Description: The total, quantity, or count of the system's information resources.
Keyword: Data, knowledge, wisdom, memory, intellectual property, message, communication, meaning.

Name: Duration of Action of Moving Object
Description: The time the object takes to perform an action. This action can occur over a very short or very long period.
Keyword: Speed, phase, frequency, natural frequency, interval, response time, latency, life.

Name: Duration of Action of Stationary Object
Description: The time the object takes to perform an action. This action can occur over a very short or very long period.
Keyword: Phase, interval, response time, duration, latency, life.

Name: Speed
Description: The velocity or rate of an object or the speed of a process or action.
Keyword: Pace, haste, drift, acceleration, deceleration, slowness, lethargy, swiftness.

Name: Force/Torque
Description: Interaction that changes the state of an object.
Keyword: Action, impact, push, pull, twist, load, inertia, acceleration, momentum, intensity, pressure, friction, clamp, voltage.

Name: Energy Used by Moving Object
Description: A measure of the object's capacity to perform work. This parameter focuses on the actual energy used (not efficiency).
Keyword: Energy burn, consumption, heat input, heating, cooling, heat dissipation.

Name: Energy Used by Stationary Object
Description: A measure of the object's capacity to perform work. This parameter focuses on the actual energy used (not efficiency).
Keyword: Energy burn, consumption, heat input, heating, cooling, heat dissipation.

Name: Power
Description: Work performed per unit of time. The rate of energy usage.
Keyword: Flow, flux, impulse, surge, robustness, horsepower, intensity, action.

Name: Stress/Pressure
Description: Force acting on a unit of area. Stress is the effect of force on an object. Stress can be tension or compression, static or dynamic.
Keyword: Compression, tension, creep, thermal fatigue, chemical fatigue, elasticity, yield, plasticity, stiffness.

Name: Strength
Description: The range (extent) to which an object can resist changes caused by applied force. Strength is the limit of elasticity, elongation, or maximum impact intensity.
Keyword: Fatigue, creep, joint, bond, force, slack, distortion, stiffness, plasticity, hardness.

Name: Stability of the Object's Composition
Description: The integrity of the object; the relationship of components that make up the object. This parameter can apply at the macroscopic level (components) or microscopic level (atoms). Chemical dissociation, decomposition, and entropy increase should be considered when the problem relates to durability.
Keyword: Inertia, degradation, decomposition, failure, oxidation, distortion, homogeneity, consistency.

Name: Temperature
Description: The measurement or thermal state of the object. It includes thermal parameters such as specific heat, thermal conductivity, thermal radiation, and thermal convection.
Keyword: Conduction, convection, radiation, insulation, melting point, freezing point, boiling point, overheating.

Name: Illumination Intensity
Description: Light flux (color, brightness, intensity...) per unit area. This parameter applies to both the brightness of the source and the illumination of the object.
Keyword: Transmission, absorption, reflection, refractive index, frequency, shadow, tone, brightness, gloss, color, infrared, ultraviolet, visible, camouflage.

Name: Function Efficiency
Description: Efficiency related to the use of the main function or functions performed by the object.
Keyword: Loss, waste, incompetence.

Name: Loss of Substance
Description: The loss or removal of elements of the object or its surroundings such as matter, materials, products, etc.
Keyword: Leakage, wear, waste, abrasion, absorption, desorption.

Name: Loss of Time
Description: Time inefficiency, meaning waiting or delays.
Keyword: Cost, delay, double effort, wasting time on unnecessary things.

Name: Loss of Energy
Description: The loss or waste of energy due to not contributing to useful activities.
Keyword: Friction, dispersion, chaos, interference, damping.

Name: Loss of Information
Description: The loss or elimination of data from or to the object. This data relates to any of the 5 human senses.
Keyword: Misunderstanding, distraction, filtering, corruption, knowledge, meaning.

Name: Noise
Description: Issues related to interference generated or received by the object or the surrounding environment. Noise in this context can be good or bad. It can relate to physical noise or noise in data.
Keyword: Scream, whistle, hum, whine, intrusion, oscillation, resonance, melody.

Name: Harmful Emissions
Description: Any form of pollution or emission released into the environment by the object.
Keyword: CO2, NOx, SO, O3, CFC.

Name: Other Harmful Effects Generated by System
Description: Internal impacts (effects) of the object that reduce the operational efficiency (quality) of the object or act inefficiently on the surrounding environment.
Keyword: Contamination, adverse effects, toxicity, irritation, abrasion, taste, arrangement/texture, mouthfeel, haptics.

Name: Adaptability/Versatility
Description: The extent to which the object can respond to external changes.
Keyword: Diversion, modulation, variation, compliance, rigidity, tolerance, universality.

Name: Compatibility/Connectability
Description: The extent to which the object can connect and is compatible with other objects.
Keyword: Standard, protocol, interface, coupling, welding, joining, isolation, incompatibility.

Name: Ease of Operation
Description: The extent to which the user can control or operate the object easily.
Keyword: Training, education, usability, learning curve, familiarization time, transportability, controllability.

Name: Reliability/Robustness
Description: The ability to perform functions as designed, in intended ways and conditions. It includes durability and issues related to performance or performance degradation of the object over extended periods.
Keyword: Life, lifecycle, lifecycle cost, service, mean time between failures (MTBF), mean time between overhauls, repair, failure, durability.

Name: Repairability
Description: Quality characteristics such as convenience, comfort, simplicity, and time to repair failures or defects of the object.
Keyword: Maintenance, assembly, disassembly, accessibility, detachability, cleanability, replaceability, serviceability.

Name: Security
Description: The ability of the object to protect itself against unauthorized access/use/attack or other adverse effects.
Keyword: Access, prevention, defense, precaution, copyright infringement, preventative measures.

Name: Safety/Vulnerability
Description: The ability of the object to resist adverse effects from external factors.
Keyword: Protection, support, emergency, fire, explosion, catastrophic failure.

Name: Aesthetics/Appearance
Description: The visual aesthetic appearance of the object.
Keyword: Beauty, elegance, attraction, suitability, ugliness, form.

Name: Other Harmful Effects Acting On the System
Description: Impacts (effects) from the surrounding environment that reduce the operational efficiency (quality) of the object.
Keyword: Unwanted effects, adhesion, jamming, contamination, UV, collision.

Name: Manufacturability
Description: Issues related to production, manufacturing, assembly, and integration with the object.
Keyword: Assembly, design for manufacture (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), ease of manufacture, tool change, setup time.

Name: Manufacture Precision/Consistency
Description: The degree to which the existing characteristics of the object match the required special or specific characteristics. Accuracy.
Keyword: Tolerance, repeatability, standard, deviation, quality, quality assurance, surface finish, parallelism, perpendicularity, precision.

Name: Automation
Description: The ability of the object to perform functions without external control or intervention.
Keyword: Robotics, repeatability, quality assurance.

Name: Productivity
Description: The quantity of useful functions (added value) or activities performed by the object per unit of time. Useful results per unit of time. Cost per unit of result.
Keyword: Robotics, repeatability, quality assurance.

Name: System Complexity
Description: The number and diversity of elements (parts) and links within the object. Complexity is also understood as difficulties in controlling and using the object.
Keyword: Interfaces, equipment complexity.

Name: Control Complexity
Description: Control complexity is the complexity of the control system (physical components or algorithms of the system) in the process of verifying the execution of the object's functions.
Keyword: Negative feedback, positive feedback, proportional, integral, differential.

Name: Positive Intangibles
Description: Intangible factors defined by human emotional reactions to the object. Positive intangibles are factors that drive the motivation to seek satisfaction. In many industrial sectors, this motivation increases intangible factors through the customer's action of purchasing or not purchasing the product or service.
Keyword: Happiness, joy, excitement, delight, comfort, empathy, love, passion, joie-de-vivre, kinship, satisfaction, peace, soul, essence, coolness.

Name: Negative Intangibles
Description: Intangible factors defined by human emotional reactions to the object. Negative intangibles are factors that drive the motivation to 'avoid pain'. In many industrial sectors, this motivation increases negative intangible factors through the customer's action of purchasing or not purchasing the product or service.
Keyword: Impatience, anxiety, stress, suffering, disappointment, hatred, rivalry, laziness, lethargy, neurosis, degradation, confusion, sadness, shock, fear.

Name: Ability to Detect/Measure
Description: The ability to perform measurements or detection on the object despite difficulties, such as: complexity, cost, time consumption, need for personnel to check or analyze activities.
Keyword: Opportunity, location, integrity, clarity, ability to find correct signs for measurement.

Name: Measurement Precision
Description: The accuracy of the measured value. Measurement error.
Keyword: Tolerance, error, repeatability, consistency, standard deviation, mean, median, mode.
